svg.text: Step 1 — PCR amplification with BsaI-containing primers
Step 2 — BsaI digestion removes recognition site, exposes 4-bp overhang
Step 3 — Complementary overhangs anneal (only one correct order possible)
Step 4 — T4 ligase seals nicks → seamless, scarless product
No restriction site remains — junction is seamless
Type IIS enzyme (BsaI) — cuts outside recognition site
Custom 4-bp sticky ends — define assembly order
Insert fragments — any number, ordered by unique overhangs
